title: Token expiry check uses strict less-than (<) creating 1-second stale-token window
author: StimeGuan
body_preview: ## Bug Description  In `knox/auth.py` at lines 107 and 113, expired token pruning uses strict less-than (`expiry < timezone.now()`) instead of `expiry <= timezone.now()`. This creates a 1-second precision window where a token that expired *at exactly this moment* is treated as still valid and will survive clean-up until the next garbage collection cycle.  ## Code Location  `knox/auth.py`, lines 10...

title: Token expiry and revocation lack Django signal emission, breaking external listeners
